name: tr_klay
caption:
IF KLAY HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

⚡ Minun: it loves to cheer on its partner. With Steph: 484 threes in one season, a record back then
🔥 Rapidash: the faster it goes, the bigger the flames. 37 points in one quarter, 13 for 13
🦐 Golisopod: it will do anything to win. Down 3-1 to OKC, then 11 threes in Game 6
💨 Accelgor: it moves with blinding speed. 60 points in 29 minutes, the first ever to score 60 in under 30
🐙 Octillery: its ability is Sniper. 14 threes in one game, an NBA record
🦋 Volcarona: when ash darkened the sky, its fire replaced the sun. 2.5 years out hurt, then ring number 4 in 2022

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Klay Thompson had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF KLAY HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Minun. It loves to cheer on its partner in battle. Him and Steph: four hundred eighty-four threes in one season, a record back then.
beats.dlg: IT BACKS ITS PARTNER.|484 THREES WITH STEPH!

beats.vo: Rapidash. The faster it goes, the longer the flames of its mane grow. Thirty-seven points in one quarter. Thirteen for thirteen.
beats.dlg: FASTER IT GOES, HOTTER IT|GETS. 37 IN ONE QUARTER!

beats.vo: Golisopod. It will do anything to win, and takes every opening it gets. Down three games to one against OKC. Game six: eleven threes.
beats.dlg: IT WILL DO ANYTHING TO WIN|DOWN 3-1: 11 THREES!

beats.vo: Accelgor. It sheds its heavy shell and moves with blinding speed. Sixty points in twenty-nine minutes. The first player ever to score sixty in under thirty.
beats.dlg: IT MOVES WITH BLINDING|SPEED. 60 IN 29 MINUTES!

beats.vo: Octillery. Its ability is Sniper. Fourteen threes in one game, an NBA record.
beats.dlg: ITS ABILITY IS SNIPER.|14 THREES IN ONE GAME!

beats.vo: And the ace. Volcarona. When ash darkened the sky, its fire stood in for the sun. Two and a half years out, then he came back and won ring number four.
beats.dlg: ITS FIRE REPLACED THE SUN.|2.5 YEARS OUT, THEN RING 4

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Thompson: drafted 11th overall by Golden State in 2011; in 2014 he and Stephen Curry set a then-NBA record with 484 combined three-pointers in a season, the Splash Brothers; January 23, 2015: an NBA-record 37 points in a single quarter, going 13-for-13 from the field; 2016 Western Conference Finals: down 3-1 to the Oklahoma City Thunder (OKC), in Game 6 Thompson made 11 three-pointers; December 5, 2016: 60 points in 29 minutes vs Indiana, first player in NBA history to score 60 points in less than 30 minutes; October 29, 2018: an NBA-record 14 threes vs Chicago; tore his ACL in Game 6 of the 2019 Finals, then an Achilles tear; after missing over two and a half (2.5) years he returned in 2021-22 and won his fourth (4) title in 2022
Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle
Rapidash: the faster it goes, the longer the swaying flames of its mane become
Golisopod: it will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening
Accelgor: having removed its heavy shell, it moves with blinding speed and ninja-like movements
Volcarona: when volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, its fire provided a replacement for the sun
